Excited to be co-moderating tonight's #educolor discussion around coalition-building between communities of color. 

My stance? Probably my best-known writing to date was around Peter Liang and Akai Gurley https://t.co/PCKv6HW117 #BLM #AAPIs4BlackLives #VincentChin #AkaiGurley
@hou_laoshi Me, too, Carly. One of the pieces I'm most proud of writing. :) #Asians4BlackLives #AAPIs4BlackLives #BlackLivesMatter #BLM
@EduColorMVMT I have also seen first-hand lots of coalition building with the #BlackLivesMatter movement around coalitions of color. I've held up for #Asians4BlackLives in the past. What say y'all?

@awakenlibrarian @EduColorMVMT Great question. As movements around #StandingRock and #BlackLivesMatter have occurred, folk have been centering Black and Indigenous peoples' struggles before other POC struggles. Not every community, of course, does this, but this has become an increasing trend.
